segments.name: Engineering and Other Scientific
segments.description: A broad service group providing technical consulting in different practices primarily in engineering for corporate, legal, insurance and government clients.
segments.evidence: The Engineering and Other Scientific segment is a broad service group providing technical consulting in different practices primarily in engineering.

segments.name: Environmental and Health
segments.description: Provides environmental, epidemiology and health risk analysis consulting on environmental hazards and their impact on human health and the environment.
segments.evidence: The Environmental and Health segment provides services in the area of environmental, epidemiology and health risk analysis.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay Exponent for consulting engagements on either a fixed-price basis or a time and material basis with hourly rates based on staff skills and experience, billed monthly.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide our services on either a fixed-price basis or on a time and material basis, charging in the latter case hourly rates for each staff member involved in a project, based on their skills and experience.
